description: Compliance/security/privacy evidence registry for DeployIQ. Contains only implementation-specific attestations supported by authoritative (primarily vendor-official) sources. Used as a hard architectural constraint by the Solution Estimator. Conservative by design: UNKNOWN is used wherever authoritative implementation-specific evidence was not found, rather than inferring SUPPORTED.
sources_policy: Vendor trust centers, vendor official compliance/security/privacy pages, and vendor official documentation are treated as primary evidence. No Solution Registry was attached to this task, so implementations were selected from the target list in the task instructions. Independent certification bodies were not directly queried; vendor-published claims about their own certifications are labelled vendor_published_attestation, not third_party_attestation, unless an independent certifying body's own page was retrieved. Aggregator/SEO/GRC-vendor sites were used only to locate candidate facts and were NOT cited as the evidentiary source; every SUPPORTED record below is sourced to an official vendor URL.

attestations.scope: Paid Services only (Gemini Developer API / Google AI Studio with an active billing-enabled project). EEA/Switzerland/UK accounts are treated as Paid Services for this purpose even when nominally free.
attestations.notes: This is a contractual data-use commitment on the standalone Gemini Developer API (ai.google.dev), NOT the same offering as Vertex AI/Gemini Enterprise on Google Cloud. See gemini_developer_api_unpaid_training_v1 for the contrasting free-tier terms.

attestations.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
attestations.scope: Unpaid Services (free-tier Gemini Developer API and direct Google AI Studio usage, outside EEA/Switzerland/UK)
attestations.notes: On Unpaid Services, Google's own terms state submitted content and generated responses may be used to provide, improve, and develop Google products and machine learning technologies, and human reviewers may read/annotate input and output. This is recorded as NOT_APPLICABLE for the 'no training' claim on this specific (free) sub-scope; it is the opposite of a no-training guarantee. Do not use the free-tier Gemini Developer API for any data requiring confidentiality or compliance guarantees.
